Chapter 87: Chapter 21 Been Waiting For You A Long Time_3

Chapter 87: Chapter 21 Been Waiting for You a Long Time_3

These military arsenals were majestic and grand, totaling thirty-five in number, currently perched high in the heavens, overlooking the mortal realm.

…

The thirty-five colossal armaments suspended in the sky had an aura as vast as the universe itself.

This was also the reason Xu Chong had not noticed them, because their presence was too overwhelming.

It’s like being in an endless, vast ocean, where you would definitely notice ships sailing above and the occasional islands.

As for the ocean itself, it tends to be overlooked.

“They… they….”

...

Xu Chong’s teeth were chattering. In his numerous preconceptions, wielding the Splitting Heaven Axe with his strength, even if he couldn’t match the thirty-six Divine Weapons, the difference wouldn’t be too significant.

Yet now, having seen the thirty-five Divine Weapons with his own eyes, Xu Chong realized from the depths of his heart that there was a gulf-like gap between the Splitting Heaven Axe and the former.

Accompanied by Xu Chong looking up to the sky.

More and more people on the battlefield also began looking up to the heavens.

“It’s Divine Weapons.”

“The Divine Weapons of my Daqi Dynasty.”

“And those of the Great Chu Dynasty.”

“Hahahahaha, the end is near for those remnants of the Defying Divine Society.”

…

Countless people from the thirty-five nations were exhilarated, some even knelt down on the ground to welcome the descent of the Divine Weapons.

In contrast, the scene at the Defying Divine Society was one of utter despair.

Especially those wielders of the Evil Soldiers, who felt an even deeper sense of heavenly, overwhelming pressure coming from the clouds.

At the same time.

Above the clouds.

The thirty-five Divine Weapons emitted tremendous mental fluctuations.

“So much flesh and souls… simply delicious…”

“And those losers… just right to be dealt with this time…”

“This breakthrough, though successful, has greatly depleted my primordial Qi, urgently needing flesh and souls for replenishment…”

“Wait, why haven’t I seen the old eighteen for such a long time…”

“Perhaps the old eighteen is also hiding somewhere transforming. He’s not done transforming yet. Never mind, I’ll enjoy these flesh and souls first…”

The thirty-five Divine Weapons dispersed, their terrifying might enveloping the entire battlefield of the Five Peaks.

“Begin to feast.”

In an instant, a Divine Weapon gently inhaled, and tens of thousands of soldiers from the thirty-five nations’ side below turned instantly into skeletons.

For the Divine Weapons, be it the thirty-five nations or the Defying Divine Society, both were merely food on the plate.

Now, due to their breakthrough transformation, they needed flesh and souls, and they wouldn’t distinguish whether the food was farmed by them or not.

“What?”

Xu Chong, looking at the thirty-five Divine Weapons above the clouds, was filled with despair.

At this moment, as the thirty-five Divine Weapons spread out and took positions in all directions, they completely sealed off the battlefield, leaving him no route for escape.

“It’s over.”

Xu Chong was resigned, feeling as if there was no way out for him today.

In such a situation, Xu Chong subconsciously began to reflect on his life.

From his birth, as well as his dad and mom, and his sister… Unfortunately, she was later taken away by that storyteller, struggling against the rule of Divine Weapons…

For some reason, Xu Chong’s thoughts wandered back to that night ten years ago.

Back then, Sikong Lun had led him into the Underground Palace, where he met the master of the Defying Divine Society, who also bestowed upon him the Splitting Heaven Axe…

Xu Chong’s memories became progressively clearer, and he seemed to remember, the final words that the master of the Defying Divine Society had said, that if he encountered an insurmountable situation, he could shout “Flame Emperor”…

Thinking of this, Xu Chong, for some reason, instinctively looked up, gazing straight at the thirty-five Divine Weapons above the clouds, took a deep breath, and shouted angrily: “Flame—Emperor!!!”

In order to shout these two words, Xu Chong burned his blood essence, even harnessing the power of the Splitting Heaven Axe.

In an instant, the words “Flame Emperor” spread in all directions, echoing throughout the entire Five Peaks battlefield.

The world suddenly fell into silence.

“Why the hurry!”

At that moment, another voice came through.

Everyone looked up to see a young emperor in a dragon robe, composed and calm, stepping onto thin air, arriving with a gaze sharp as a torch and an aura of authority.

The young emperor ascended into the heavens step by step, reaching a position level with the thirty-five Divine Weapons.

Lin Yuan suspended in the air and looked towards the thirty-five Divine Weapons.

“I’ve been waiting for you for a long time.”
